UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information and role.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A message in a chat conversation between a teen and the assistant.

userId.description: The ID of the user who sent or received the message.

isHearted.description: Whether the message has been hearted by the teen.

theme.description: The extracted wellbeing theme (assistant messages only).

ParentTheme.title: Parent Theme
ParentTheme.description: Anonymized wellbeing themes shared with parents.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent who can view this theme.

childId.description: The ID of the child the theme relates to.

lastUpdated.description: When the theme was last updated.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Chat messages for a specific teen.
